prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished square game inventory crafting-material icon, "Prime Requiem Blueprint".
Primary request: create a premium science-fiction engineering blueprint item, a physical holographic data slate, using the attached approved Prime Requiem character art only as a visual reference for the machine's identity.
Subject: one dark gunmetal and black titanium engineering slate with thin beveled angular corners, small crimson-red mechanical clamps and luminous cyan circuitry. Its broad translucent deep-blue glass surface displays a large, immediately readable cyan technical line drawing of the reference's tall armored humanoid: long legs, angular horned head, broad red-and-white plated shoulders, circular emerald chest reactor and oversized single-edged blade. The reactor is picked out in luminous emerald and a few weapon annotations in crimson. Add two restrained exploded-view mini diagrams for the chest reactor and the blade, fine construction lines and measured guide marks. It must clearly read as a valuable technical schematic, not a completed character card or a photograph.
Composition: a single coherent slate in slight three-quarter perspective, centered, nearly filling a square canvas with generous 8% padding on all sides. The character schematic remains large and legible at inventory-icon size. All projections and glow remain close to the object.
Style: meticulous high-end 2D science-fiction game item illustration, clean metal edges, restrained luminous holograms, strong silhouette, crisp hierarchy. Navy, titanium, cyan, emerald accents and controlled crimson highlights matching Prime Requiem.
Constraints: actual transparent background outside the item; no scenery, no blood-moon background from the reference, no hands, no people holding it, no ornamental parchment or fantasy scroll, no inventory tile frame, no watermark, no text or letters, no unrelated logos, no excessive particles. This is new item art, do not alter the original character image.
